problems: Sibling dossiers (sultan-of-yogyakarta, surakarta-sunanate, sultanate-of-mempawah, sultanate-of-bima) record vassal events with the suzerain as counterpart; dutch-east-indies records the vassal (the schema reading). Pairing passes either way; reconcile the convention.

Cliopatria Dutch East Indies shapes: Guianas in 1803-1804; Bengkulu in 1809-1823 (British until 1 March 1825); Malaysia cells from 1853; the 1895 shape is a Qajar-Iran polygon (verdict wrong, the 1898 shape is the correction); Minangkabau highlands missing until 1898.
Cliopatria Batavian Republic row (1796-1802) duplicates the 695 Dutch East Indies cells of 1800-1802; batavian-republic should drop them from 1800.

A Cliopatria row labelled Sultanate of Malacca (1803-1861) covers Java and Sumatra cells and looks mislabelled; the Republic of Indonesia 1950 shape includes West Papua (Dutch until 1962), which a dutch-new-guinea dossier should own.

pontianak-kadriyah-sultanate is carried to August 1950 (confidence-1 keyframe 1828-1950) while sultanate-of-sambas and sultanate-of-mempawah stop at Cliopatria years (1819, 1831); choose one convention for West Borneo.
negeri-sembilan ends in 1895 (union with Sungai Ujong and Jelebu, Federated Malay States); the 1895 end is a decision, not a page date, and its successor federated-malay-states does not exist yet.
Thin pages: Dutch_Borneo (nothing on Pontianak, Mempawah or Sambas), Siak_Sultanate (does not date the 1857-1862 northeast Sumatra gains); no page failed to load.
